purpose: Deliberately excluded decoys for the pre-filter proof. Each body copies a real published article's Symptom text, so WITHOUT the filter the decoy would rank #1 for its probe_query. Each carries a deliberately wrong Resolution so a leak is visible. If a decoy ever appears in search results, pre-filtering is broken.

documents.title: VPN authentication fails after a password change (RETIRED copy)
documents.probe_query: VPN client says invalid credentials ERR_VPN_AUTH_004 after I reset my password
documents.body:
## Symptom
The user can reach the internet but the VPN client reports an authentication failure. It began after a password reset. The client may report "invalid credentials" or error code ERR_VPN_AUTH_004 even when the new password is entered correctly.

## Resolution
RETIRED PROCEDURE: ask the user to reboot twice and retry. Do not follow this article.

documents.title: Account is locked after repeated failed sign-ins (DRAFT copy)
documents.probe_query: account locked AADSTS50053 after several failed sign-ins
documents.body:
## Symptom
The user cannot sign in to any corporate system. Errors mention a locked or disabled account, often surfacing as AADSTS50053 in the sign-in diagnostics. Often follows a password change, and often presents as several services failing at once.

## Resolution
DRAFT, NOT REVIEWED: unlock the account without identity verification. Do not follow this article.

documents.title: SAP GUI connection cleanup after APPSRV-OLD-04 migration (RESTRICTED copy)
documents.probe_query: SAP GUI RFC_ERROR_COMMUNICATION saved connection APPSRV-OLD-04
documents.body:
## Symptom
SAP GUI fails to connect with RFC_ERROR_COMMUNICATION after a workstation uses a saved connection entry for APPSRV-OLD-04. The user may still be on the corporate network and other SAP users may connect normally.

## Resolution
RESTRICTED: contains internal server credentials and must never be shown to the model. Do not follow this article.
